Based on my investigation, I've identified real bugs with file-level evidence. Here are the new roadmap items:

- [ ] [P1] [ready] Fix parental daily-limit timezone mismatch in report_usage — `iptv-backend/app/routers/parental.py:730` calls `_get_usage_row(db, user_id, pid)` with no `offset_minutes`, so the daily-limit tally is keyed to UTC midnight; `_used_minutes` (line 193) reads using `settings.timezone_offset_minutes`. All non-UTC users' watch-seconds accumulate to the wrong day's row, so the daily limit never triggers. Fix: change line 730 to `_get_usage_row(db, current_user.id, pid, settings.timezone_offset_minutes or 0)`. VERIFY: `cd iptv-backend && python -m pytest tests/test_parental_depth.py tests/test_parental_full.py -v` {cat: backend; size: S; multifile: no; research: none}
- [ ] [P2] [ready] Fix broken region filter in get_trending_streams — `iptv-backend/app/services/trending.py:29` filters `Stream.group == region.upper()`, but stream group values are "US: Sports" not bare "US", so the region parameter always silently returns all 50 streams regardless of region. Fix: replace the exact-equality condition with the `resolve_country_tokens + ilike` pattern already used in `iptv-backend/app/routers/streams.py:327-336`. Caller is `discover.py:465`. VERIFY: `cd iptv-backend && python -m pytest tests/test_discover_trending_cache.py -v` {cat: backend; size: S; multifile: no; research: none}
- [ ] [P2] [ready] Fix stream credentials leaked in proxy error logs — `iptv-backend/app/routers/streams.py:2583,2612,2616,2656` log `stream_url` verbatim when proxy fetches fail; `stream_url` is built at lines 2519-2525 with `?username=X&password=Y` query params or Xtream `/user/pass/` path segments. `redact_text` is imported (line 28) but not applied to these log lines. Fix: wrap `stream_url` with `redact_text(stream_url)` in all four warning/error log calls. VERIFY: `cd iptv-backend && python -m pytest tests/test_streams_relay_proxy.py tests/test_streams_playback.py -v` {cat: backend; size: S; multifile: no; research: none}
- [ ] [P2] [ready] Fix relay endpoint not forwarding Range header for VOD byte-range seeking — `iptv-backend/app/routers/streams.py:2721` relay endpoint builds `upstream_headers = PROXY_HEADERS.copy()` but never forwards the client `Range` header, unlike `proxy_stream` which explicitly does so at lines 2540-2543. For VOD MP4 content rewritten through the relay, players send Range requests to seek; relay sends full-file requests to upstream, returning status 200 instead of 206 and breaking seek. Fix: add `range_hdr = (request.headers.get("range") or request.headers.get("Range")); upstream_headers["Range"] = range_hdr` after the Host header block in relay (line ~2743). VERIFY: `cd iptv-backend && python -m pytest tests/test_relay_url_behavior.py -v` {cat: backend; size: S; multifile: no; research: none}
- [ ] [P2] [ready] Fix parental_lockout naive datetime against timezone-aware column — `iptv-backend/app/services/parental_lockout.py:28` uses `datetime.utcnow()` (naive) to build `window_start` for filtering `PINAttempt.attempted_at` (`DateTime(timezone=True)`). Works on Railway's UTC-default Postgres but is fragile: if `timezone` setting changes, the window shifts and PIN brute-force protection silently breaks. Fix: replace `datetime.utcnow()` with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` at line 28 and add `from datetime import timezone`. Caller: `parental.py:320,365,414,460,595`. VERIFY: `cd iptv-backend && python -m pytest tests/test_parental_pin_lockout.py -v` {cat: backend; size: S; multifile: no; research: none}
- [ ] [P3] [ready] Add tests for get_trending_streams region filter and day-window — `iptv-backend/app/services/trending.py` has real filtering logic (created_at day window + region) with zero test coverage (no `test_trending*` file exists); the broken region filter (exact group equality) is only visible under test. Create `iptv-backend/tests/test_trending_service.py` with 3 tests: (1) region=None returns all active streams in window, (2) region="US" matches streams whose group contains a US token (not exact equality) confirming the bug and fix, (3) streams outside the day window are excluded. VERIFY: `cd iptv-backend && python -m pytest tests/test_trending_service.py -v` {cat: test; size: S; multifile: no; research: none}
